notes: Version 1 rejected: uniform/symmetrical. Version 2: disconnected unequal clusters. Runtime PNGs copy the generated RGBA pixels exactly; no resampling, recoloring or inferred alpha.

nature.v1: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: nature transparent watercolor perimeter overlay for an Exploritaire playing card, NOT a complete card or mockup. Asymmetric climbing jade and moss-green vines, broad irregular leaves and a few loose tendrils, open gaps between clusters. Composition: portrait canvas aspect 5:7; ornament follows a tall rectangular perimeter at x=8% and 92%, y=6% and 94%, with organic projections into the outer padding. Keep all painted marks within canvas, no clipped tips. Keep the entire central rectangle x=23%..77%, y=18%..82% completely transparent for rank readability. Thin sparse side edges, slightly fuller corners, asymmetric and broken, never a uniform rectangular border. Style: match the broad visibly separate angular gouache and watercolor brush masses of the Hero storybook reference visible in conversation; loose pigment washes, uneven feathered edges, selective hard pigment boundaries, a few clear value groups, no smooth airbrush modeling. Paper texture only inside paint. Actual transparent alpha outside AND inside the perimeter; preserve opaque cream highlights. No paper backing, no background, no text, numerals, symbols, card, bevel, frame line, ground shadow, glow or watermark. Paint only the elemental ornament.
nature.v2: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a transparent portrait 5:7 game-card perimeter adornment made of moss/jade vines and broad leaves. CRITICAL: radically ASYMMETRIC, sparse disconnected organic clusters, NOT A FRAME. No bilateral or rotational symmetry, no matching corners, no continuous rectangle, no evenly spaced stamps, no four corner ornaments. Composition: one dominant irregular cluster climbing the LOWER LEFT edge from y=53% to 90%, one much smaller isolated curling stroke across part of the TOP at x=40%..68%, and a tiny different accent on RIGHT at y=31%..42%. Leave upper-left, upper-right and lower-right corners empty. Leave entire bottom edge and most of right edge completely empty. Each cluster differs in shape, size, thickness, direction and density. No connecting border. Large transparent gaps separate every cluster. Central rectangle x=24%..77%, y=19%..82% must stay completely empty for card rank. All marks contained inside canvas with 3% padding. Broad angular storybook gouache and watercolor brush masses, merged loose washes, clear grouped values, uneven feathered pigment edges and occasional hard paint boundaries, lively imperfect silhouette; paper texture subordinate to visible brushwork, only inside paint. Genuine transparent alpha background and empty center. Preserve opaque cream highlights. No text, card, numerals, paper rectangle, shadows, glow, smooth digital shading or vector contours. This replaces rejected uniform symmetrical border paintings.
